items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: What about Blanc Charlie? Steve Lewis, he could play. What about Blanc Charlie?

ctx.x: You know. What about Blonde Charlie? Don't interrupt him. Don't interrupt him. Don't interrupt him. Tell him. and different things like that. Every time we used a good chord, we were right time music then. We didn't know nothing about jazz, you know. Every time we used a good chord, right time music then. What about Blanc Charlie? Steve Lewis, he could play. What about Blanc Charlie?
